decisions.reason: The original decoder evaluates a logarithm at zero for mismatched pairs, e.g. independent competitor/output in the binary identity channel. Proof 1.1 now defines a measurable extended score, assigning minus infinity to zero likelihood and outside the output probability-one support. Proof 1.2 integrates only over that support and obtains E L <= 1; Markov and the finite union bound retain exactly the claimed error estimate. The Statement and all hypotheses remain unchanged.

The cited thm-dedekind-complete explicitly states that the Dedekind construction of R is order-complete, and its proof concludes that R has the least-upper-bound property. Real numbers here are Dedekind cuts, so its bounded-set assertion applies directly to the nonempty right-secant slope set. Ordered-field structure is already part of that supplier context. The endpoint proof forces U=a almost surely; for E U>a, the supremum of right slopes is bounded by every left slope and gives the asserted integrable affine majorant.

The unqualified cross-moment identity in original step 3.1 is false for i=j: a nondegenerate coordinate has E G_i^4=3 sigma_i^4, not sigma_i^4. The repaired step restricts factorization to distinct independent coordinates and uses the computed fourth moment on the diagonal, including sigma=0 and the empty combination. Tail comparison, finite-interval integration by parts, vanishing boundary terms and scaling establish the scalar moments first. The Statement and AC assumption are preserved.

The explicit set {1,2,...} and all sums already specify positive input labels, so there is no missing row under that local convention. However writing this set as N conflicts with def-natural-numbers, where 0 belongs to N. Replacing N by N_{>0} removes this nonfatal notation conflict without changing the model, cost, information functional or supremum. Bounded finite-output entropies ensure the conditional series converges. The companion example supplies all positive rows and is unchanged by the clarification.

F3 incorrectly attributed the entropy endpoint convention to def-natural-logarithm, which defines log only for positive arguments. The existing countable-channel definition and finite-simplex entropy lemma explicitly supply 0 ln 0 = 0; F3 now attributes it to F1/F2. Every positive input row has strictly positive binary entropy, so every probability sequence yields I<ln 2. The explicit equal mixture on labels 2k and 2k-1 has uniform output and information ln 2-h_2(1/(k+2)), tending to ln 2. Positive-label clarification of its supplier changes none of these uses.

F6 omitted the exchangeability hypothesis in the pruning supplier Statement. This is a nonfatal interface overstatement because the actual ensemble uses IID message codewords and therefore is exchangeable. F6 now states the hypothesis, and step 3.1 verifies it explicitly. Strict mean-power slack gives q_n <= Var(Q)/(n(P-mu)^2), Gaussian fourth moments justify that finite variance, and information-density convergence plus threshold decoding gives a_n -> 0. Pruning preserves asymptotic rate and enforces every retained codeword cost; orthogonal norm preservation transfers the code.

The feedback-code definition introduced n without the positive blocklength condition carried by def-fixed-length-channel-code. Allowing n=0 makes its displayed expected average cost and rate undefined. It now explicitly requires an integer n>=1, preserving all causal-map, expected-cost and asymptotic-capacity clauses. Finite alphabets and finite letter costs make each positive-blocklength expectation finite. Its direct theorem consumer uses sums over t=1,...,n, a uniform index in [n], and Fano divided by n, all sound on this explicit domain.

The scalar normal-law definition supplies AC and the one-dimensional Gaussian density, not independence of coordinates. A1 now states only that scalar interface. Step 1.1 explicitly obtains transformed independence from the diagonalization argument of F1, where F2 acts on the underlying independent standard-normal vector. Matrix multiplication verifies UKU^T=diag(1,4) and U^TU=I, so energy and code laws are preserved. At P=2 the water level is 3, allocating (2,0) and giving one half ln 3. The erroneous A1 attribution is nonfatal because the needed multivariate conclusion was already supplied by F1.
